name: RC-B10-0282/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on media freedom in Georgia, particularly the case of Mzia Amaglobeli
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making demands. It calls for the immediate release of journalist Mzia Amaglobeli, who was arrested in Georgia in January 2025 and faces four to seven years in prison. It condemns Georgia's government for attacking independent media, civil society and the courts. It asks the European Union to support Georgia's independent media and asks member states to impose sanctions on Georgian officials.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states demands and opinions.
- The demands target Georgia's government, its jailed critics and its media.
- Next, the text goes to EU governments, the Commission and others.
